get_rebootmode;if test ${reboot_mode} = factory_reset; then run recovery_from_flash;else if test ${reboot_mode} = update; then run update;else if test ${reboot_mode} = quiescent; then setenv bootconfig ${bootconfig} androidboot.quiescent=1;setenv vout_init enable;run try_auto_burn;else if test ${reboot_mode} = recovery_quiescent; then setenv bootconfig ${bootconfig} androidboot.quiescent=1;setenv vout_init enable;run recovery_from_flash;else if test ${reboot_mode} = cold_boot; then run try_auto_burn;else if test ${reboot_mode} = fastboot; then fastboot 0;fi;fi;fi;fi;fi;fi;
